Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], an '''''Acclamator''-class assault ship''' was used to transport a [[Unidentified Zillo Beast/Legends|captured]] [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beast]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] following the [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|Battle of Malastare]].
